## The binding claim rule

The newest committed `sig.probe-run/1` record is dated **2026-11-16**
(`probes/p37.61a-harm-republish-post.json`) — outside the live-claim
policy's 24 h freshness window. So **no new unqualified production-state
assertion was written**: every refreshed claim was re-dated, bounded
(`queued` / `gated` / `prepared_not_executed` / "as recorded"), or left
untouched as a dated grandfathered record. `check_live_claims corpus`:
109 claims — all grandfathered, **0 violations**; the range form judged
every added line (0 violations). Nothing claims the schema deploy,
export/re-cut chain, release registry or promote chain is green — the
docs record the queued/blocked posture per the 2026-11-20 PHASE LOG.

113 → 109 grandfathered production claims stay their dated records.
